title: Functions: return a cost and preserve the original minutes
goal: Trace arguments, parameters, return, and original state; distinguish a message from a result and verify Знач.

prerequisites.text: Complete BSL fundamentals: variables, types, conditions, and loops. Know how to preserve a separate source and run your training infobase.

sections.title: Why this task matters
paragraphs: You can calculate a total in one handler. Now you need a calculation that can be called twice and whose returned numbers can be added. A function supplies a value to its caller; a message merely displays something. Check the two roles separately.

Read the worked example and predict a changed input. The independent task uses a different contract. Save the previous training source before replacing a module; a personal Nexus mark is not an assessment of your explanation.

sections.title: Give a reusable calculation a name
paragraphs: The same cost formula must serve different requests. A function is a named part of a program that accepts inputs and returns a value to the calling expression. Стоимость(30, 1200) passes 30 minutes and an hourly rate of 1200. The function does not need to know which screen supplied them.

A procedure performs an action; it does not return an expression value as this function does. Сообщить displays information to a person. Displaying 600 alone does not give the caller a number it can add to another cost. Here the function returns a number, the handler assigns it to Результат, and only then displays it.

sections.title: The complete worked example and its result
paragraphs: This complete source has a function and an event handler in the application module. The function is outside the procedure. Startup calls the handler; it receives 600 and then displays the original 30 minutes. Declaring the function does not execute it.
Match code and result by each statement’s role. Explain matching output through inputs, execution order, and state; one observed run does not check every possible variant.

sections.title: Arguments outside, parameters inside
paragraphs: Минуты and ТарифЗаЧас in the declaration are parameters. The caller’s variable and the literal 1200 are arguments for this call. Position determines their correspondence. Two numeric arguments can have the right type yet the wrong meaning. Minutes must be divided by 60 when the rate is hourly.

Знач on these numeric parameters keeps parameter assignments from modifying the caller’s variable by reference. It is not a promise of a deep copy of every mutable collection. Mutable data needs an explicit contract describing allowed changes and copying; the collections lesson develops that distinction.

sections.title: Trace the important transitions
paragraphs: The worked function does not reassign its parameter. The second message 30 alone therefore does not explain Знач. In a separate variant, the function assigns hours to its minutes parameter:30/60=0.5. With Знач the caller keeps 30; without it the caller variable changes.
Before the next statement, record state separately from messages already displayed. This finds the first divergence rather than guessing from the final line.

sections.title: Your prediction before revealing
paragraphs: The worked handler passes 45 minutes at 1200 per hour. What are the returned result and original minutes?
Write your answer before revealing it. Identify the changed input and unchanged rule, then compare with the changed example.

reveal.title: Check the prediction
paragraphs: Match the changed values with the same rule. This checks transfer rather than memorisation of the previous final line.

sections.title: State the contract before the formula
paragraphs: This function accepts two nonnegative numbers, returns a cost rounded to two decimal places, and neither writes documents nor changes the caller’s duration. Type checks precede arithmetic; range checks precede calculation. Zero minutes is valid and costs zero in this particular exercise.

A negative duration raises an exception instead of silently becoming a free service. Returning zero for invalid input would hide an input error in a legitimate total. Callers must know both the valid result and the rejected inputs. A consistent result type on valid calls makes later calculations and tests easier.

sections.title: A faulty variant and its first divergence
paragraphs: Remove Знач only from the first parameter in the hours-conversion variant. The cost remains 600, but the caller variable becomes 0.5. A matching first line hides the side effect. Compare both result and original state; Знач does not promise a deep copy of collections.
Keep the faulty variant separately. Restore the working version and repeat the positive case. Do not change an expectation merely because the program printed something else.

sections.title: Declarations and execution are different
paragraphs: The complete example declares a top-level function and a ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы event procedure. The platform invokes the procedure at startup; that procedure invokes the function. Declaring the function does not execute it. Do not place its declaration inside the previous handler. Preserve the old module and replace this training module’s complete text.

Trace startup → handler → function → return to handler → two messages. For 30 and 1200, the cost is 600 and the original duration remains 30. Try 45 next. In a separately preserved experiment try −1 and inspect the rejection; keep a known working version.

sections.title: See the values and direction
paragraphs: The diagram unfolds the selected sequence. Labels do not replace code: match each transition to a statement and record what remains unchanged.

The diagram shows the new discounted calculation: 45 minutes becomes 0.75 hours inside the function and 540 is returned. The right node still holds 45 minutes. The returned value and preserved caller variable are two distinct properties.

sections.title: Now a different independent task
paragraphs: Write СтоимостьСоСкидкой(Минуты, Тариф, Скидка):45 minutes at 800 per hour with a 10 percent discount. Return the rounded number 540 and separately display the original 45 minutes. Minutes/rate must be nonnegative; discount is 0…100. Reject invalid values. You may convert the parameter to hours while preserving the caller’s original.
The worked example is not a ready solution to this task. Use a separate starter; reveal the reference on request after your own attempt. Viewing it must not replace saved or unsaved work.

sections.title: How to check transfer
paragraphs: The independent main run displays 540 and 45, not 540 and 0.75.
Label each control input, expected observation, and reason in advance. Use rejection where the contract requires it; do not turn an unknown result into a convenient zero.

sections.title: The exact work location in 1C
paragraphs: This complete source has a function and an event handler in the application module. The function is outside the procedure. Startup calls the handler; it receives 600 and then displays the original 30 minutes. Declaring the function does not execute it.

In your separate training infobase, save the source, update the database configuration, and launch a new session from Designer. Distinguish the editor, saved configuration, and running version; an old session does not prove the new text ran.

paragraphs: 60 minutes without a discount gives 800; zero minutes gives 0; discount 101 is rejected before calculation.

The source and expected messages accompany the explanation. Actual images of the complete worked example come from a separate training infobase; they are not your run or proof of your authorship. Record your independent work separately.

sections.title: What is established and what still needs explanation
paragraphs: This observation concerns a numeric parameter and this exact source. Знач does not make every structure an independent copy. The run does not validate real business billing rules, server permissions, or learner authorship.

Before marking completion, explain one changed input of your own. A technical pass, matching messages, and your completion mark are different facts; understanding is discussed through explanation and transfer.
